page: Microsoft Azure DC64ads_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCadsv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor using the x86_64 architecture, providing 64 dedicated vCPUs. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, which equates to 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For local storage, the DC64ads_v6 includes a 2458 GB local SSD. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no dedicated graphics processing units on this instance.

With a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and substantial local SSD capacity, this instance is designed for general-purpose workloads, database hosting, and applications requiring fast local scratch storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance, making it a cost-efficient choice for resource-dense enterprise applications that do not require GPU acceleration.
description: Microsoft Azure DC64ads_v6 is an x86_64 virtual machine from the DCadsv6 family, operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor, paired with 256.0 GB of system memory to establish a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. For storage-intensive tasks, the server is equipped with 2458 GB of local SSD storage and supports Premium Storage for high-performance external disk configurations. It does not include integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention, offering a cost-efficient solution for resource-dense deployments. This hardware profile makes the DC64ads_v6 highly suitable for general-purpose enterprise applications, relational database management, and workloads that require dedicated compute resources alongside high-capacity local solid-state storage.
